contested_thread: PD-001 no-listener kernel-enforcement over arbitrary native tool closures on Linux (novel-but-same-subdomain objection every round 31,32,34,36,37; each folded soundly, exhaustive-corner refutation supply)
scoping_question: Given the comprehensive layered fail-closed design (static hermetic launcher + static hermetic sandbox-builder; arch-gated kernel-inherited un-droppable seccomp denying bind/listen/accept/inet-DGRAM/io_uring/socketcall; close_range fd cleanup; offline/online net-profile split; sealed-memfd identity; authenticated content-addressed full tool closures), is any REMAINING Linux-platform-corner no-listener objection a plan-authorization BLOCKER or an Argo implementation-spike (bounded honest-limit per repo proposal-lifecycle + E6 precedent)?

verdict.rationale: The proposed architecture (seccomp-BPF under NO_NEW_PRIVS, static hermetic launcher, arch gating, close_range fd scrubbing, inet DGRAM/io_uring denial, and netns profiling) establishes a conceptually sound, fail-closed kernel invariant against inbound listener creation. The residual risk of uncovering obscure Linux platform bypasses is an exhaustive enumeration problem, not a conceptual architectural flaw. Per the E6 repository precedent, this exhaustive platform-mechanism proof is a bounded Argo implementation spike.
verdict.required_plan_text_if_spike: HONEST LIMIT (Argo Spike): The exhaustive enumeration of every residual Linux syscall, loader, and namespace corner case that could bypass the seccomp-BPF no-listener enforcement. Settled in plan: The core architecture relies on an arch-gated, kernel-inherited seccomp-BPF filter applied under NO_NEW_PRIVS by a static hermetic launcher, augmented by offline/online netns profiles and inherited fd cleanup. Open implementation choice: The exhaustive auditing of the Linux syscall matrix. Interim fail-closed detection: CI pipeline network observability monitoring the confined process tree.
verdict.detection_fallback: Continuous CI-time eBPF and strace monitoring of the confined process tree to detect and fail closed upon any blocked syscall attempts or unhandled socket creation.

disposition: Non-convergence of the no-listener/native-trust thread escalated to the Gemini referee per the standing 'no-cap-referee' directive and the E6 scoping-adjudication precedent. Referee ruled argo-implementation-spike: the no-listener enforcement ARCHITECTURE is conceptually sound and fail-closed; only exhaustive enumeration of residual Linux syscall/loader/namespace corners remains, a bounded platform-engineering spike. Its prescribed honest-limit text is folded into candidate-approach.md §6b as SPIKE-PD001-NOLISTENER-COMPLETENESS.
post_ruling_resolution: Ruling applied by recording the spike in §6b with settled-in-plan (the layered kernel-inherited seccomp architecture) / open-implementation-choice (exhaustive Linux syscall/loader/namespace-corner audit) / interim fail-closed detection (CI-time eBPF+strace observability of the confined tree failing closed on any blocked-syscall or unhandled socket-creation attempt). Formal disposition of the deferral is a Council/Eye S2/S3 decision, not this document's assertion. Genuinely NEW plan-level defects in OTHER areas remain in scope and are fixed normally.
